name: Kottayam
tagline: The land of letters, latex and lakes
summary: Kottayam: Kerala's printing and literary city, with Kumarakom on Vembanad Lake, rubber estates, Syrian Christian churches and Vaikom's history.

history.overview: Kottayam was a centre of early Malayalam printing, with the Church Mission Society press established in the early 19th century. The Vaikom Satyagraha of 1924–25 began here.

timeline.event: Church Mission Society press brings printing to Malayalam.
Vaikom Satyagraha challenges caste restrictions on temple roads.

unique: Syrian Christian heritage with painted churches

bestTime.why: Dry, pleasant for backwaters and bird watching.

lookFor: Painted churches at Valiyapally and Cheriapally
